title: Code and data for: Evidence, Not Doubt: Self-Verification in LLM-Based Arabic Entity Linking to Wikidata
description: An LLM agent that links Arabic entity mentions to Wikidata and checks its answers, mostly against Wikidata, before accepting them; with every comparison system of the paper (an ungrounded LLM critic, a fixed NIL rule, retrieval baselines), all run traces, the review tools, and a blind-reviewed, corrected ELNER-DZ test sample. The data in data/ and results/ is licensed under CC BY 4.0 and derived from ELNER-DZ.
